description: Use this when an agent needs a company lookup for KYB/business verification: legal name, status, jurisdiction, address, LEI/CIK/ticker, match confidence (GLEIF + SEC). kind="lookup" (default); kind="pro": parents, filings, optional officers. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: lookup (10 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (25 sats or $0.025 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

country.description: ISO country or subdivision, e.g. US, DE, US-DE.

officers.description: kind=pro: add SEC Form 4 officer names/roles.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).

name: get_company_data
title: Company lookup (KYB, LEI)
